scope: Strict OpenAPI and runtime contract for the private location-scoped spatial-autocorrelation read.

constraints.numeric_values: finite numbers or null after existing source sanitization
constraints.pagination: strict request-bound location, limit 1..50, offset 0..10000; a short page cannot advertise more results, and continuation cannot exceed the offset ceiling

behavior.authorization: existing signed location-scoped read policy preserved
behavior.cache: Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie preserved
behavior.invalid_projection: fixed sanitized 500 response; no-store headers preserved
behavior.offset_ceiling: service reports has_more=false when next offset would exceed 10000

limitations: The response contract covers the autocorrelation endpoint only; other saved geostatistics reads remain unaudited in this batch.
This is source/API behavior evidence, not populated-data, live OIDC, or broad tenant-isolation acceptance.
